problem: Quarantine reactivation binds novelty to an aligned evidence key + content fingerprint pair, but provenance identity is not part of the same aligned novelty tuple. A new key/fingerprint pair can therefore trigger reinspection while provenance is missing, replayed from the quarantine baseline, or otherwise not demonstrably new/bound to that item.
risk: source identity drift can be mistaken for information gain
borrowed or missing provenance can reopen a quarantined branch
VAJRA may change downstream routing without proving that the post-quarantine item is a provenance-bound new observation

requiredBehavior.reactivation: Require at least one aligned evidence tuple whose key, fingerprint, and provenance identity are all explicitly present and bound to the same item; key and fingerprint must be novel relative to quarantine baseline and provenance must be explicitly auditable rather than missing or silently borrowed.
requiredBehavior.hold: Missing provenance, provenance-array misalignment, or a novelty pair whose provenance cannot be bound to the same item must remain REPEATED_METABOLIC_CONTEST / HOLD.
requiredBehavior.boundary: This does not claim semantic novelty, source independence, truth, or capability assimilation. It only prevents provenance-free novelty from changing VAJRA routing.

provenance.fixture: synthetic de-identified quarantine branch fixtures only
